text:
Priya: Quick one — 4:00 PM panel for candidate (SWE IC2) got moved into a compact 40m slot. We need: scribe, a debrief lead, and a tiny rubric tweak because they did a take-home.
Elena: I can scribe if no one else volunteers.
Sam: Thanks Elena. What rubric tweak are you thinking?
Priya: System design weight -> drop from 30% to 15%, take-home/code exercise weight -> bump to 40%. Keep behavioral + collaboration the same. This is just for this candidate since interview was shortened.
Jordan: Agree with that change. Also please flag the take-home in the debrief so reviewers focus on implementation tradeoffs.
Sam: Got it. Small ask — can we add a checkbox in the debrief form: "Take-home considered in scoring" so reviewers normalize?
Priya: Yes — new checkbox makes sense. Quick patch: in the review form use this snippet, copy/paste ok:
```
- take_home_considered: boolean
- take_home_notes: text (optional)
```
Elena: I will capture that in notes and tick the box.
People Ops Bot: Calendar updated: https://calendar.company/meet/4pm-panel — scribe set to Elena. Reminder will go 10m before.
Sam: One more thing — for calibration later, tagging this candidate on the "take-home" label would help when we run score normalization. Can you add tag?
Priya: Done, added label `take-home-short-panel`.
Jordan: Thanks all. I'll do a 15m async debrief window after the panel to collect quick notes.
Elena: Great — will post the capture link in the thread after the interview. :thumbsup:
Priya: awesome, closing loop. If anyone needs to swap scribe ping here and I can reassign.
